description: Galas, a living oak gall as big as a head, a round woody green-brown ball with small holes, a crooked angry face of bark, cracked open at the top with a swarm of small black wasps bursting out, floating, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the gall alone, no leaves, no ground, no background, the whole gall inside the picture, its wasps too
